name: Arcade Dusk VGA
note: The single source of truth for every colour in the game. The ramps below are KEY colours; the engine interpolates each one up to `stepsPerRamp` shades at load, giving a ~224-colour VGA-era palette with smooth gradients. Sprites, backgrounds, UI and font must use only colours from that expanded set. Tools read this file; the game imports it.
transparencyRule: Alpha is binary. A pixel is either fully opaque (255) or fully transparent (0). No partial alpha - it produces halos when scaled and breaks the pixel-art read.
rampNote: Key colours are the anchors of each ramp, darkest first. ramp(name, i) still addresses these by index, so existing painters are unaffected; shade(name, t) addresses the smooth expansion with t from 0 (darkest) to 1 (lightest).
